What we do

One partner for communication, security & visibility

Five connected solutions that keep your people talking, your sites covered and your operation accountable — deploy one, or run them together on a single platform.

Radios & Push-to-Talk

Instant voice over cellular — no range limits, no base stations. Talk across the street or across the border.

  • Group & private calls on 4G/LTE coverage
  • GPS location on every handset
  • Voice recording & central management
  • Rugged handsets for the field

Dispatcher & Guard Monitoring

A live control room in your browser. See every patrol, checkpoint and alert as it happens — and prove guards are actually walking their rounds.

  • Live map of guards & vehicles
  • Checkpoint tap/scan verification
  • Missed-round & SOS alerts
  • Shift, patrol & incident reports

Body Cameras & Video

Body-worn cameras that capture every interaction and stream back for evidence, accountability and dispute resolution.

  • HD body-worn recording
  • Live video pull from the field
  • Secure, time-stamped footage
  • One-touch incident capture

Employee Wellness & Safety

Lone-worker devices that watch out for the people who work alone — man-down detection and one-press SOS straight to the control room.

  • Man-down & no-motion alerts
  • Panic / SOS button
  • Lone-worker check-ins
  • Live escalation to dispatch

Visitor Management

Replace the paper logbook with digital sign-in — photo, ID and number-plate capture, with a searchable record for every site.

  • Digital sign-in / sign-out
  • Photo, ID & plate capture
  • Blacklist flagging
  • Multi-site audit trail
The dispatcher platform

See every patrol, as it happens

Your whole operation on one screen — guards, vehicles, checkpoints and alerts across every client site, live. If a round is missed or an SOS is pressed, you know in seconds.

  • Live positions on one map

    Every guard and vehicle plotted in real time, across all sites and borders.

  • Proof of patrol

    Checkpoint taps and completion rates show exactly who walked their rounds — and who didn't.

  • Instant exception alerts

    Missed checkpoints, SOS presses and man-down events escalate straight to the control room.

Devices in the field

Hardware that backs up the platform

Cameras and safety devices that feed straight into your dispatcher view.

Body-Worn Video

Evidence on every shoulder

Body cameras record every patrol and every interaction, so disputes are settled by footage, not by argument. Pull live video from a guard in the field, or review time-stamped recordings later.

HD recordingLive streamTime-stampedOne-touch captureSecure storage
Worker Wellness & Safety

Looking out for lone workers

Wellness and lone-worker devices watch over staff who work alone or after hours. Man-down detection and a one-press SOS raise the alarm automatically and escalate straight to dispatch with the worker's location.
